class.name: MidiDriver
class.brief_description: Sends MIDI to instruments and other targets, with a tempo, a transport and sample-exact timing.
class.description: A real-time MIDI driver: notes, controllers and pitch bend sent from scripts, ad hoc or planned on a beat grid, and handed to the target bound to each channel. Events planned ahead land on the exact audio sample. [codeblock] var midi := MidiDriver.create(1) # MIDI 1.0 value ranges add_child(midi) midi.set_channel_target(1, $Piano) midi.play() var n := midi.note_on(1, 60, 100) # now, held until n.off() midi.note_on(1, 64, 90, 0.5, midi.next(1.0)) # on the next beat, half a beat long [/codeblock] [b]Channels[/b] are 1 to 16, as on MIDI gear (Godot's [InputEventMIDI] counts from 0). One target may listen on several channels. [b]When:[/b] every message takes an optional last argument [code]at[/code]: [constant NOW] (the default), or a position from [method next], [method after] or [method at_beat]. "Now" is heard one audio block (about 11.6 ms) later; anything planned ahead is exact. [b]Values[/b] are in the ranges of [member midi_version]: velocity, controllers and pressures 0-127 and pitch bend -8192 to 8191 for MIDI 1.0; 16-bit velocity, 32-bit controllers, pressures and pitch bend for MIDI 2.0. Targets always receive them at MIDI 2.0 resolution. [b]Targets[/b] are objects with two methods, so a GDScript synth can be one: [codeblock] func midi_event(time_us: int, source: int, kind: int, channel: int, index: int, value: int, note_id: int) -> void func midi_stop(time_us: int, source: int, mode: int) -> void [/codeblock] [code]time_us[/code] is on [method get_time_us]'s clock; [code]kind[/code] is an [enum EventKind], [code]mode[/code] a [enum StopMode], and [code]source[/code] the driver's instance id. The driver keeps running while the scene tree is paused; [method pause] pauses the music.

method.name: after
method.description: The position [param beats] beats from now, as an [code]at[/code]. [constant NOW] while stopped.

method.name: all_notes_off
method.description: Ends every note this driver is playing, now or at [param at].

method.name: at_beat
method.description: The next time the song reaches beat [param song_beat], as an [code]at[/code]: with a loop, the next time round. A beat already passed plays now; one outside a running loop is never reached (NaN, which the messages refuse). [constant NOW] while stopped.

method.name: channel_pressure
method.description: Channel pressure (aftertouch for the whole channel).

method.name: clear_loop
method.description: Turns the loop off.

method.name: control_change
method.description: Controller [param controller] (0-127) to [param value]: 1 is the mod wheel, 7 volume, 10 pan, 11 expression, 64 sustain, 74 brightness.

method.name: create
method.description: A new driver for MIDI [param midi_version] (1 or 2), which sets the value ranges. Add it to the scene tree: it runs every frame.

method.name: get_channel_target
method.description: The object listening on [param channel], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_controller_max
method.description: The largest controller value for this driver's MIDI version: 127, or 4294967295.

method.name: get_pitch_bend_max
method.description: The largest pitch bend: 8191, or 2147483647. The smallest is one more than its negative.

method.name: get_position
method.description: The song position now, in beats (a loop folds it back).

method.name: get_time_us
method.description: Microseconds on the clock targets receive times on.

method.name: get_velocity_max
method.description: The largest velocity for this driver's MIDI version: 127, or 65535.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: [code]true[/code] while the transport runs.

method.name: next
method.description: The next multiple of [param grid] beats on the song's grid, as an [code]at[/code]: [code]next(1.0)[/code] is the next beat, [code]next(4.0)[/code] the next bar in 4/4, [code]next(0.25)[/code] the next sixteenth. Exactly on the grid already: now. [constant NOW] while stopped.

method.name: note_off
method.description: Ends every note of this driver on [param channel] and [param key]. To end one particular note, use [method MidiNote.off].

method.name: note_on
method.description: Starts a note and returns it. [param velocity] 0 is a note-off, as in MIDI. With a [param length] in beats above 0 the note ends by itself; otherwise it sounds until ended. Returns [code]null[/code] for values out of range.

method.name: panic
method.description: Silences every note at once and stops, for emergencies.

method.name: pause
method.description: Pauses the music: the position stays, sounding notes end (their release tails ring out), and what was planned plays after [method play].

method.name: pitch_bend
method.description: Pitch bend for the whole channel; 0 is no bend.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts the transport, or resumes after [method pause]: then each channel's last controller, pitch bend, pressure and program values are sent again first.

method.name: poly_aftertouch
method.description: Pressure on one key.

method.name: program_change
method.description: Selects program (sound) [param program], 0-127.

method.name: seek
method.description: Moves the song to beat [param song_beat]. Every note ends and planned events are dropped, as a DAW re-plans from the new position. A paused or stopped transport stays so.

method.name: set_channel_target
method.description: Sends [param channel]'s events to [param target], an object with [code]midi_event[/code] and [code]midi_stop[/code] methods; [code]null[/code] for none. Notes already sounding end where they started.

method.name: set_loop
method.description: Loops the song between beats [param start] and [param end], once it gets there.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops and goes back to the start: every note ends, and planned events are dropped.

members.member: The tempo, in beats per minute. A change takes effect from now; planned events move with it.
How far ahead events are handed to targets. Longer copes with longer frame drops; shorter means [method pause], [method seek] and tempo changes take back less.
1 or 2: the MIDI version whose value ranges the driver takes. Targets always receive MIDI 2.0 resolution.

signal.name: beat
signal.description: Emitted on each beat while playing. [param running_beat] counts beats since [method play]; [param song_beat] is the song position there (a loop folds it back). Emitted on the main thread, so up to a frame late: for gameplay, not for timing notes (plan those with [method next] instead).

constants.constant: As an [code]at[/code]: at once, heard one audio block later.
[code]index[/code] is the key, [code]value[/code] the 16-bit release velocity.
Drop the events from this source not heard yet; sounding notes go on (a tempo change).
As [constant STOP_WITHDRAW], and end every sounding note from this source with a note-off (pause, stop, seek).
As [constant STOP_RELEASE], but silence the notes at once ([method panic]).
